note: Preregistered before any grid run. The default configuration stays the reported configuration regardless of results; no test outcome is used for parameter selection. The VPIN block is defined here because no VPIN-as-feature definition exists in the workbook or roadmap text.

baselines.B3: the v3 frame: OFI, OFI z-score, imbalance, spread z-score, signed trade volume
baselines.B5: the v4 frame (controls-only): B3 plus signed-flow window, OFI/depth, lagged signed flow and OFI, quote and trade event rates, trailing realized volatility, microprice displacement

decision_rule: Each decision row is fixed by information available at its bar close: the trailing 30-bar feature window must be fully observed, a full 20-bucket VPIN window must have completed before the bar close, and the VPIN value 3 bars earlier must be defined. The VPIN at a bar close is the last completed bucket value at or before the bar close; bucket volume is a fixed 15.0 BTC, never derived from a session total. Labels: direction is the sign of the forward mid return over the next 3 bars; absolute return is the 3-bar absolute forward return above the training-fold median; spread widening is the spread at the horizon bar strictly above the spread at the decision bar; adverse markout is the forward return running against the bar's net aggressive flow side, with zero-flow rows excluded from that outcome only.
censoring_rule: A row is supervised only if every bar feeding its features (trailing 30 bars) and every bar in its forward target window was actually observed. Carried-forward bars are never promoted to fresh observations. Rows before the first full VPIN window are outside the P3 row set for every config.
selection_rule: No test outcome is used for parameter selection. The default configuration stays the reported configuration regardless of results. Every grid cell is reported for every outcome.
absent: Cross-session confirmation: blocked. P3::confirm is a separate blocked-input unit; this pilot reports exploratory observations on the archived sessions only.
Depth beyond the touch: unavailable in archived data; only touch-accessible fields are used.
Deeper-book imbalance and queue imbalance: not recorded in the archive.
